Author: Jake Koenig
Summary: People throw around "unfalsifiable" too casually. Is it really unfalsifiable or are you lazy? e.g. some say yudkowskian doom is unfalsifiable but every day thousands work towards falsifying it by building the machine God and seeing what happens
